# Dialer Performance Analytics

A product-analytics case study on outbound dialer performance: connect rates,
speed-to-lead, spam-flag impact, multi-line efficiency, and rep coaching data.

**Independent portfolio project.** The dataset is 100% synthetic (generated by
`seed.py`, deterministic with seed 42) and is **not affiliated with WAVV
Communications or any dialer company**. It explores the same class of product
questions a CRM-embedded power dialer team would ask.

## The dataset

`seed.py` generates `dialer.db` (SQLite):

| Table | Rows | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `reps` | 12 | Sales reps across SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise |
| `leads` | 3,000 | Lead source, creation time, spam-likely phone flag |
| `calls` | 5,396 | Every dial attempt: outcome, duration, lines used (1–3), voicemail drop, minutes-to-first-call |

```bash
python3 seed.py          # regenerates dialer.db (no dependencies, stdlib only)
```

## Analyses (`queries/`)

| # | Question | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | When should reps dial? | **9 AM is the peak window (32.2% connect rate)**; 11 AM–12 PM also strong (26–28%). After 7 PM it collapses to <7%. Product takeaway: power the dialer's "best time to call" scheduling around morning windows. |
| 02 | Does speed-to-lead matter? | Dramatically. Leads called **within 5 minutes connect at 40.5%**; at 5–30 min it falls to 32.1%, 30–60 min to 24.9%, and 1–4 hours to 17.7%. Product takeaway: sub-5-minute SLA alerting is the highest-ROI feature in the funnel. |
| 03 | What do spam flags cost? | Spam-likely numbers connect at **10.4% vs 20.3%** on clean numbers, with a 22.4% failed rate (vs 13.8%). Product takeaway: number health monitoring and automatic number rotation directly protect connect rates. |
| 04 | Does 3-line dialing pay off? | Per-dial connect rate is flat across 1/2/3 lines (~18–19%) — the win is **throughput, not conversion**. Product takeaway: sell multi-line on dials-per-hour, and watch for rep burnout signals in talk-time data. |
| 05 | Do voicemail drops earn callbacks? | Leads that got a pre-recorded drop were eventually contacted at **8.7% vs 6.0%** without one — a modest but real lift. Product takeaway: auto-drop is worth keeping, but don't oversell it. |
| 06 | Who needs coaching? | Connect rates span 16.8%–20.6%; **Nora Haddad (Enterprise) books 6.3 meetings per 100 dials**, nearly 2x the lowest rep. Product takeaway: pair call recordings of top converters with low-meeting-rate reps. |

## Run it

```bash
python3 seed.py
sqlite3 dialer.db < queries/02_speed_to_lead.sql
```

No third-party dependencies — Python 3 standard library only.
